productObjects.task: durable bounded work Context Space owned by VibeHub
productObjects.thread: persistent Codex conversation and replaceable execution carrier linked to a Task
productObjects.turn: one Human-to-Agent interaction within a Thread; completion is never a Task Outcome
productObjects.project: zero-or-one owning work scope; repository-backed v1 uses one current Project
productObjects.room: Project-level namespace that owns durable Context, never a Task or execution
productObjects.context: explicit durable claim included by Task contract or Human choice for one Turn
productObjects.reference: read-only pointer to external reality that grants no writeback authority

workspaceOrder: Task identity, Project or Standalone, primary posture and substate
Outcome or intent plus collapsed Acceptance and constraints
governed Context and Room provenance for the next Turn
persistent native Codex conversation and Composer
Evidence, Outcome and exact source provenance

lifecycleDisclosure.draft: definition and blocking/deviation facts primary; conversation may explore but cannot claim execution
lifecycleDisclosure.ready: Start is primary; Context packet is inspectable before opening the Thread
lifecycleDisclosure.running: trusted current Turn and activity are primary; live state comes only from app-server
lifecycleDisclosure.waitingHuman: the exact approval, input or Human-authority boundary appears inside the conversation and the Task carries NEEDS YOU
lifecycleDisclosure.verifying: CLOSE_OUT remains RUNNING/verifying; independent adjudication is the recommended next action
lifecycleDisclosure.deviated: non-success Outcome returns presentation to DRAFT plus DEVIATED and preserves prior proof
lifecycleDisclosure.done: successful Outcome is terminal DONE; conversation remains readable history

contextPacket.ordering: direct Ticket Context references first, then Human-selected Context IDs; lexical and de-duplicated within each group
requiredTruth: successful direct-prerequisite Outcomes and their acceptance-linked Evidence

threadLifecycle.start: host creates one persistent Thread, records a visible VibeHub Task name for bounded restart linkage, and sends the full packet in the first Turn
threadLifecycle.continue: host rebuilds a fresh packet and starts another Turn on the linked Thread
threadLifecycle.steer: host rebuilds the packet and calls turn/steer only with the exact active expectedTurnId
threadLifecycle.approveOrAnswer: exact app-server server request ID and supported response
threadLifecycle.interrupt: turn/interrupt and authoritative interrupted replay; partial items remain
threadLifecycle.refresh: thread/read restores durable history but never live presence
threadLifecycle.restart: thread/resume is required before new live work; Task link is recovered from persisted packet identity
threadLifecycle.additionalThread: explicit fork or new packet-linked exploration Thread; never a Subtask
threadLifecycle.closeout: Evidence completeness routes to an independent Agent; completed Run does not imply Outcome

rooms.presentation: inline inspectable list and one-Turn selector, not a permanent second graph
